model.geometry: cantilever plate 45 x 14 x t mm, clamped root
model.mesh: SfePy Q2 hexahedra, 24 x 8 x 3 vertices, 57,510 tetra-equivalent DOF
model.solver: K phi = lambda M phi, shift-invert, lowest 5 modes
model.validation: FEM vs Euler-Bernoulli bare-arm f1 within 1.5-2.0%; skill solver cross-check within 1e-10

recommended.infill: 5-6 top/bottom skins, 5 walls, 60-80% gyroid, 100% at arm roots and motor mounts

conclusions: The first vertical arm mode is crossed during spool-up (2.5-10.7k RPM), not at hover or full throttle.
Radial prop unbalance is horizontal and mainly excites lateral/frame modes; balancing props is the highest-value fix.
Carbon fibre is not modelled as isotropic; a stiffer frame moves resonances rather than automatically reducing vibration.
PLA 4.0 mm is the recommended budget compromise; use washers, soft-mount the FC, enable RPM filter if supported.
limitations: arm-only model, not full-frame modal analysis
isotropic material screening values, not measured printed samples
no flight test or blackbox data
